title: I would appreciate if people could come together to transform my 20 massive video game stories from being AI written into human written with me
author: Flashy_Philosophy576
selftext: I know ya’ll already hate me for using AI to create the stories but I would sincerely like for ya’ll guys to help this ninth grader transform his AI written video game stories into human written by rewriting it to show more emotional and narrative depth while also keeping some of the core ideas that the AI has given. **The story behind why I am asking this is because I posted my AI written story for a video game and was honest about that I used AI to make it. I got a lot of hate like I should telling me to write on my own. Then there was a person who commented on how it would be a lot more useful if you had other people helping you fix what was wrong and not use AI instead.** I ask of ya‘ll to just help me fix these entire story lines and for clarification this might take months but I know I can’t do it alone as I know I should have people helping me as a team in a video game company has many people writing the storylines for this games. I want collaborate with many people to make these game stories more narratively and emotionally in depth for **I want to make a successful video game company but not with AI generated video game stories.** Once again, I am just asking for people to pitch and help make video game stories that will truly standout when I become way older and start to build a video game company. **Rest assured I will give credit to everyone who worked on the story for they deserve it.**

comments.author: Crimes_Optimal
comments.body:
This is asking for free work, and also somewhat missing the point. 


If you're trying to move to making non-AI generated stories, you're better off throwing out what it's given you entirely and come up with your own stories. Even if they're simple, even if they're objectively shitty, *you improve by doing.*


That's why there's so much resistance to beginners especially using AI tools - you skip learning the fundamentals. Like Jake the Dog said, being bad at something is the first step to being sort of good at something.


If you're intimidated by the quality of modern AAA stuff, I suggest stepping back. You aren't Bungie, you aren't Naughty Dog, you aren't Square Enix. You're you, and your doing to name the things you can make. Trying to write at a huge AAA level is going to ring hollow at best. 


Toby Fox started off making a shit post Halloween Hack of Earthbound where the final boss has an attack called PSI Bitchkill Omega. Then later, when he grew up, he made Undertale and Deltarune.


He wouldn't have had the skills or confidence to make those without making a cringy edgy thing first.


The first thing you make is not going to be a masterpiece. Neither is the second. Some day, though, you'll turn around at your previous work and see the good in it. 


There'll be no good to see if you never start.

comments.author: intLeon
comments.body: Nobody is gonna do it for free. They want you to either pay up or stop doing anything if you dont have the money. Stop having fun!

replies.author: Flashy_Philosophy576
replies.body: Well as mentioned, a lot of people dont like the video game stories that I created with AI just because it was made with AI and yes I know that people will probably ask me to pay up which is something I should have thought about before asking

replies.author: intLeon
replies.body: If it is just hated because it is AI then the hate is not objective. Find people that are less extremist. Request constructive critisizm out of ai context and refine your work comparing it to other stories. It is just plain text overall.

replies.author: Flashy_Philosophy576
replies.body: By any chance could you explain what you mean by people that are less extremist?

replies.author: intLeon
replies.body: Hating someone's work just because its ai generated is a subjective behaviour. Show your work to people who dont know what anti/pro ai is. Because even if you were the next shakespeare anti ai people would dislike your work and bully you.

replies.author: Flashy_Philosophy576
replies.body: Thanks for the clarification. Will definitely try to do that.

replies.author: Flashy_Philosophy576
replies.body: Im sorry for asking so many questions but it is just that I have many things going on in my head about this. I just wanted to ask if it was alright if my story ideas were created with AI or would it be better if I instead created story ideas from just my brain? Once again, I apologize if I am asking so many questions and sound a little bit annoying with all these questions.

replies.author: intLeon
replies.body:
You can, no one is against it. If thats what you enjoy and if you have enough time why not. Overall it lets you have more control. Im a game developer and I use ai only for method context. I still write my own code for example.

However if you are short on time you should experiment in small scale and refine ai output to have a decent quality. Its not generate and use level of advancement for certain areas yet. You should only use ai if it has an advantage over the classical methods or unless you enjoy it alone.

comments.author: Lazy_Firefighter5353
comments.body: No! All you do is fine. I hate it when people turn their back when they learned one used AI. But for me, AI makes it easier. Of course nothing beats human work, but AI is there to help us out.
